crossRefs.note: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children…

people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Amorites
people.line: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel

people.name: Heshbon
people.line: Amorite city conquered by Moses, allotted to Reuben

people.name: Sihon
people.line: Amorite king of Heshbon, defeated by the Israelites.

translations.web: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the children of Ammon;
translations.bsb: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites who reigned in Heshbon, as far as the border of the Ammonites;
translations.kjv: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;
translations.asv: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;
